# Publication fixture — DOCX acceptance record

The host must create `journal-manuscript.docx` from the exact inspected `journal-manuscript.md` projection. Human acceptance checks that the file opens as a real Word document and retains the title, abstract, headings, table, caption, citations, references, uncertainty, the `NOT_COMPARABLE` meaning expressed as non-comparability, and the partial-scope limitation.

This fixture does not claim that a host-only DOCX generation capability was exercised. If the host cannot generate or open DOCX, deliver the Markdown projection, report the capability gap, and do not fabricate a successful DOCX result. A future scientific edit returns to canonical `draft.md` and is re-projected; Word is not a second source of truth.
